target_customer: Corporates and funds that must measure, report and reduce carbon emissions, initially via an API for businesses to calculate and offset footprints
problem: Companies wanted to reach net zero but lacked tools to calculate their carbon footprint and buy credible offsets.
business_model: B2B SaaS carbon accounting, with an early API and offsetting offer
product_category: Carbon accounting and net zero software

founders.name: Freddie Evans
founders.background_notes: Per Pulse2 2023: two years at BCG then two years as a fintech venture investor at Augmentum.

founders.name: Chris Winchurch
education: Master's in electrical engineering, Imperial College London
Half an MBA at Harvard Business School

founders.name: Freddie Green
founders.background_notes: Pulse2 2023 says strategy consulting background and that he left Newton to join; the YC page lists him without a bio.

competitors.name: Project Wren
competitors.what: Consumer subscription that calculates emissions and funds retired offset projects, from YC Summer 2019

competitors.name: Cloverly
competitors.what: API for developers to buy carbon offsets
competitors.funding_then: financed by Alabama Power Company per source

competitors.name: Pachama
competitors.what: Forest offset marketplace using machine learning and satellite imagery for verification

technical_complexity.rationale: A calculation engine, emissions factor data, an API and later data ingestion and reporting. Standard engineering with domain data work.

defensibility.rationale: Reporting workflows and ingested data create some lock in, but the field filled quickly with funded rivals and reporting rules changed the product.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbent bought it early. Novisto partnered with Minimum for three years and acquired it in March 2026.

market_need_then: Corporate net zero pledges were rising in 2020 and TechCrunch in January 2020 described investors and utilities seeding carbon offset startups; later EU and UK reporting rules added demand per 2026 coverage.

branding.domain_note: Held minimum.com; the home page now says Minimum is now part of Novisto.

identity.voice_and_tone: Net zero and decarbonisation focus; product names such as Carbon Atlas

rebrands.why: Product line folded into Novisto after the acquisition; whether the Minimum name is retired is not stated

brand_strength.rationale: A generic single word with little press about the brand itself; coverage focuses on funding and the acquisition.

pivots.from: Carbon calculation and offsetting API for businesses
pivots.to: Enterprise carbon accounting and reporting software
pivots.why: 2021 coverage describes the API and offsetting, 2023 and later describe enterprise carbon accounting with consultants; the pivot date was not found

outcome_analysis: Minimum raised a 2.6 million dollar seed in June 2021 led by Octopus Ventures and, per BetaKit, more than 18 million dollars in venture funding by its March 2026 sale to Novisto after a three year partnership. The terms were not disclosed. It rode corporate net zero demand and reporting rules, but the many funded carbon accounting vendors and the unstated price suggest a modest exit.
notes: BetaKit says more than 18 million dollars raised, which exceeds the single recorded 2.6 million seed, so later rounds exist but were not found in sources opened. Aggregators give totals of 2.7 to 5.3 million and a YC led pre-seed of about 125 thousand pounds, unverified. The YC directory still shows Active while the acquisition was announced 2026-03-31. Competitors are from January 2020, before the batch, because no coverage from the batch period naming rivals was found. Name origin not found.
